chip.description: PSAC rotate/zoom (ROZ) tile layer generator with internal tilemap RAM (taxonomy §4.18 and the §6 adjudication: an affine tile layer is still a tile layer).
chip.notes: Classification fixed by docs/taxonomy.md §6 (Konami K051316 -> video-tilemap, rule V3). Board usage from src/mame/konami/konamiic.txt in MAME 0.288, which lists 051316 as "(roz)" on Ajax, Chequered Flag, '88 Games, Bottom of the Ninth, Ultraman, Hot Chase, Over Drive and Rollergames.
